digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Tuesday, September 8, with 12 calendar entries, three urgent items, seven carried-over tasks, and no active reminders. The day’s priorities are to clear Amazon Connect access and channel blockers before the kickoff sequence, confirm the training audience, and finish the executive updates deck during the 11:00 AM focus block. The main risk is a compressed afternoon: the 2:15 PM Group 4 kickoff conflicts with the EPMO TL meeting, and the 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1 overlaps Group 2 UAT; Teams also shows three testers without Salesforce UAT access.

items.label: Clear Amazon Connect UAT access and channel blockers
items.detail: Complete the 11:00 AM readiness check and confirm the technical-team path for Luis David Lopez Garcia, Rodney King, and Miguel Rojas, who were reported without Salesforce UAT access. Also verify that external testers can reach the Round 2 channel before the 2:15 PM kickoff.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or routed through Halo, including the required permissions and monitoring, before the UAT sequence advances.

items.label: Finish the executive updates deck
items.detail: Use the 11:00 AM slide block to complete the requested review and add the slide covering EPMO projects completed in August before the weekly leadership discussion.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP and training path
items.detail: Training starts today while the SOPs remain under review. Confirm that training can proceed, secure the remaining approvals, and protect the September 15 Contigo launch.

items.label: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet
items.detail: This cleanup remains open across several briefings. Close stale entries and leave one current operating view before this week's portfolio reviews.

items.label: Clarify the Toggl capacity model and escalation path
items.detail: Document how capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will inform staffing.

items.label: Confirm the Enterprise Knowledge Management project record
items.detail: Confirm with Eugenia whether the recently deleted project record was intentional and which record should remain authoritative.

items.label: 10:30-11:30 AM - Double-booked start and readiness block
items.detail: The Jhara 1:1 overlaps SVC Daily Standup at 10:30 AM. At 11:00 AM, the required Amazon Connect access check overlaps the EPMO slide focus block.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Protected work, then CSO leadership
items.detail: Use the noon blocked space for unresolved deck or UAT preparation before the CSO GLs Huddle at 1:00 PM.

items.label: 2:00-3:00 PM - EPMO leadership conflicts with Group 4 UAT
items.detail: EPMO TL Weekly Catch Up runs 2:00-3:00 PM while the required Group 4 kickoff starts at 2:15 PM. Confirm coverage before the block begins.

items.label: 3:00-5:45 PM - Amazon Connect kickoff sequence
items.detail: Group 2 starts at 3:00 PM and overlaps the 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1. Groups 3 and 1 follow at 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM, leaving little recovery time for access failures.

items.label: Approve the Amazon Connect training audience
items.detail: Thiago proposed including confirmed non-attorney users, all 26 Round 2 testers, and eight non-attorney Staff Augmentation users while temporarily holding 83 attorney-pending profiles and Juan Chinchilla. Confirm the approach so Evelin can load the audience this afternoon.

items.label: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access
items.detail: Approve or decline Sara's SharePoint request for Training Agenda.xlsx after confirming that the Client Services training material is appropriate for her role.

items.label: Reply to Thiago's September 17 reschedule request
items.detail: Confirm whether the Thiago 1:1 can move to Thursday, September 17 while next week's Amazon Connect UAT and go-live work is being arranged.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - Thiago 1:1 conflicts with SVC standup
items.detail: Choose the priority or delegate coverage before Wednesday begins.

items.label: 2:00-3:00 PM - EPMO team meeting overlaps the Astrid 1:1
items.detail: The Astrid 1:1 begins at 2:30 PM, halfway through the EPMO team meeting.

items.label: 3:30-5:00 PM - Laura, weekly prep, and Sara
items.detail: The Laura 1:1 is followed immediately by a 4:00 PM preparation block and the Jean/Sara 1:1 at 4:30 PM.
